text:
maya (PM): Quick sync — drafting PRD acceptance criteria for gradual release of model v4. Need alignment on canary schedule, per-tenant pin TTL, rollback triggers, and experiment metrics.
sam (eng): propose simple staged rollout: 1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% across 4 steps. 30m hold per step for infra metrics, 2h total for tenant ramp testing.
li (sre): sgtm but we need solid SLO gates for each step: p99 latency delta < 100ms absolute AND error_rate not > 0.3% absolute or 3x baseline for 10m.
anita (prodops): add automated rollback window: if any gate trips, rollback to previous stable for 1h and freeze pinning for affected tenants. Also propose per-tenant pin TTL default 24h, extendable via support.
rohan (customer success): customer ask: some enterprise tenants want pinned versions for 2 weeks. Can we support longer TTL per contract?
maya (PM): yes, support per-contract overrides but require manual approval + audit log. Default 24h for self-serve.
sam (eng): adding experiment acceptance criteria for quality: on our curated prompt set (200 prompts) quality should not regress by >1.0% exact-match or >2.0% for subjective score. Rolling average over last 200 evals.
li (sre): include safety checks: no increase in policy-moderation hits >0.2% absolute and no spike in unknown tokens/retokens (indicates model hallucination loop).
anita (prodops): rollout config sketch (for Redwood runtime):
```
rollout: 
  name: model-v4-canary
  steps: [1, 5, 25, 100]
  hold_minutes: [30, 60, 120, 0]
  pin_ttl_default_hours: 24
  allow_manual_override: true
  per_tenant_pin_limit_hours: 336 # 2 weeks for enterprise via approval
```
rohan (customer success): nice. Also add explicit opt-out flag so customers can keep using v3 even if traffic routed to v4 globally.
sam (eng): good call — implement tenant-level routing with explicit pin precedence: tenant_pin -> experiment_assignment -> global_routing. Pinned tenants never autoupgrade unless pin TTL expires or support unpins.
li (sre): define rollback triggers as rules (concrete):
- if p99 latency increases by >100ms relative to 24h baseline for 10m
- OR error_rate > 0.3% absolute AND >2x baseline for 5m
- OR automated quality regression on eval harness: exact-match drop >1.0% over 200 samples
- OR safety hits >0.2% absolute for 30m
When triggered: automatic rollback to previous model version and page oncall + create incident with tags [rollout, model-v4].
maya (PM): add experiment measurement plan: primary metric = customer conversational quality (hybrid score), secondary = cost per token, tertiary = latency p99. Use Bayesian A/B with 95% credible interval and early stopping if prob(v4 > v3) < 0.05 after min 4k samples.
anita (prodops): ops note: ensure canary run writes per-tenant sample logs to S3 with redaction, and a hook to run the eval harness nightly during rollouts.
sam (eng): snippet for experiment config to enforce rollback gates in code:
```json
{"gates": {"latency": {"p99_delta_ms": 100, "window_mins": 10}, "errors": {"abs_pct": 0.3, "multiplier": 2, "window_mins": 5}, "quality": {"exact_match_drop_pct": 1.0, "sample_size": 200}}}
```
rohan (customer success): for enterprise rollout comms: please add a clear table of what "pinning" means and steps for support to extend/remove pins.
maya (PM): will draft PRD section. Action items: 1) Sam to add enforcement hooks + config schema (due EOD Tue). 2) Li to codify SRE thresholds into alerting runbook + test smoke (due Wed). 3) Anita to update prodops runbook and pin override flow + audit logs (due Thu). 4) Rohan to get list of tenants requiring >24h pins and contracts (due Fri).
li (sre): will also simulate fault injection during next staging window to validate auto-rollback.
sam (eng): pinging @deploy-bot to schedule a canary deploy to staging later today.
deploy-bot: scheduled: canary-deploy-model-v4 -> staging at 2027-12-15T18:00:00Z. CI: green.
maya (PM): thanks everyone — I'll attach the draft PRD acceptance criteria in the thread tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
